If you own a local towing company, you'll want to utilize email marketing to maintain your competitive edge in your community. Email marketing is a powerful tool for building connections and establishing relationships with potential partners. You can also use email marketing to build trust, grow your business, and boost profits. Whether you're looking for potential partners or new customers, having an email marketing strategy is a must-have.

We're here to help you develop an effective email marketing strategy you can use to reach your sales and revenue goals. Here are 10 towing email marketing tips to implement:

1. Automate Your Follow-ups

Are you tired of scheduling every follow-up after a sales call or meeting? Are follow-ups becoming a tedious process for your team? Use email automation to automate your follow-ups and sales emails to ensure you never miss another touch point. This can help you streamline customer communication and improve the overall customer experience.

With a business management platform like Meridian Local's, you can create workflows using triggers to automate email marketing and sales initiatives. You can trigger a follow-up after an appointment is scheduled, a deal closes, or when a customer reaches out to learn more about your services. You can also base the triggers on location, buyer habits, and more.

2. Send Surveys

Surveys provide key insight into what's working and what's not. You can use this guidance to make meaningful changes in the workplace. If someone has a negative experience with your company, you can follow up with them and address their concerns. This will help you grow trust with your target audience. You can also use surveys to create case studies. If someone has a positive experience with your company, you can use their experience to highlight your value.

3. Add Personalization

Personalization can boost engagement and lead to higher conversion rates. Adding someone's name, company, or specific details about their appointment is a great way to provide your customers with a more personalized experience. The small added detail can help build loyalty and improve the customer experience. Email marketing tools like Meridian Local have built-in personalization tokens you can use to create personalized campaigns using the data found in your cloud-based CRM.

4. Request Feedback

Asking your customers to review you on Google or Yelp is a great way to improve your reputation. This can also increase your star rating on Google Business Profile, which can help you get noticed by new customers. You should ask your customers to review you within 24 hours after you complete a service.

5. Scheduling Appointment Reminders

After a customer schedules an appointment, follow up with an email reminder. This added touch can help eliminate no-shows and keep everyone informed. This also ensures that your customers can confirm all appointment details and make changes.

With Meridian Local, you can accept appointment requests directly on your website and allow your customers to reschedule or cancel their appointments whenever they need. This will help improve the customer experience and ensure everyone's needs are met.

6. Turn Customer Experiences Into an Email

Did you partner with another company to provide towing services to a niche community? Did you recently help a customer through a tough time? Turn their stories into an email marketing for towing campaign. This is a great way to highlight your value while making your marketing more conversational. You can pull inspiration from recent surveys or ask your customers to share more details about their experience in a follow-up. Once you have the content, you can turn it into a case study to engage with prospects or past customers.

7. Re-engage with Past Customers

Re-engagement campaigns keep your business top of mind with your target audience. You can send emails to past customers sending them discounts or informing them about your new services or company updates. This is a great way to maintain your reputation and ensure your business is the first they think of when they're ready to work with you.

8. Seasonal Offers and Discounts

Are you struggling with the slow season? Try engaging with your customers using seasonal offers and discounts. This is a great way to get creative with your marketing campaigns. You can provide special offers to get people to use your services.

9. Segment Your Sends

The truth is, everyone in your database doesn’t want to be hit with a marketing email. Implementing email segmentation by location, buyer behaviors, purchase history, and demographics can help you get more strategic with your approach to email marketing for towing businesses. A CRM like Meridian Local’s can help you segment and personalize your campaigns more effectively. This is a great way to get more creative with email marketing campaigns.

For example, if you want to boost business in a specific community, you can send a campaign focusing on people in that area. You can personalize the campaign with community photos to improve engagement.

10. Improve Your Strategy With SMS Marketing

Sending SMS messages alongside your email marketing for towing campaigns can help you maximize your brand awareness while reaching a larger audience. To use SMS marketing effectively, you'll want to shorten your email marketing campaigns to 160 characters or less.
